Rationale: the implementation (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.auditMetaItem`) has shipped for many releases (CHANGELOG-verified on `origin/main`); the REST audit door compiling its request literal against nothing is the declared-surface gap, and the repo's ruled pattern for it is the optional-member catch-up (`getMetaItemLayered` precedent).

⚠️ Fold candidate with **#11679** (the `deleteMetaItem` request-schema catch-up — same file, same shape); chain-head claim carries the serial check. Same path-limb note as there: `packages/spec/src/**` ⇒ contract-review gate on path; content reading `Clause-②: no` (catch-up to shipped behaviour), state it explicitly in the claim.
